title: Rainbow Redstone
description: Make your redstone rainbow in pure vanilla! Optionally includes full customization in-game using respackopts mod.
body:
# Rainbow Redstone

This is a fully vanilla compatible resource pack for **any** version 1.13 and above, that makes the redstone dust rainbow (meaning you don't need *any* mods to use this!). It also offers full customization _in-game_ of many different aspects listed below, however this **requires** the [ResPackOpts](https://modrinth.com/mod/respackopts) mod and minecraft version 1.20.1+. Other rainbow components are coming soon, check out the gallery to see how this currently looks like!

## Features:
- In-Game Customization of: ([ResPackOpts](https://modrinth.com/mod/respackopts) required, mc version 1.20.1+)
  - Redstone dust color per signal strengh
  - Redstone dust type
  - Redstone dust distance off the surface
  - Signal strengh numbers
  - Signal strengh numbers color
  - Signal strengh numbers offset from the redstone dust they're on
  - Redstone dust item type
- Full vanilla useability (without the customization)
  - Color customization for dust available in vanilla from mc 1.17+
- Compatibility with sodium and any other mods and resource packs
  - Color customization with sodium present is **not functional**, however all other features still work and the game still displays the texture as normal

![Feature availability](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/78610a5f8617d48a0a5b7a831371e555df8bde2c.png)


<details>
<summary>How to change colors without respackopts and/or in versions <1.20.2</summary>

1. Either un-zip the pack as a folder, or open it using 7zip or winrar
2. Head to the following directory inside of the pack: "Rainbow Redstone 1.0.0\assets\minecraft\shaders\core\"
3. Open the file "default_colors.glsl" _(recommended: make a backup of it first)_
4. Change any numbers you wish that say "red", "green" or "blue" beside them, they're organized by signal strengh, with the colors for the in-game numbers being at the bottom of the file
5. Save the file and close it, if needed, click "yes" on the 7zip/winrar popup to update it in the archive
6. Put it in your resource pack folder like normal, and activate it in-game, or if it's already active, then click F3 + T in-game
7. Enjoy! _(p.s. please make sure you only ever have 1(!!) version of the pack in your resource pack folder at a time, even if they're not activated)_

</details>



## Coming soon:
- Rainbow redstone components, including repeaters, comparators, torches, etc
- Animations for rainbow effects
- Changes for dust particles with the help of mods (or core shaders potentially)
---

### Important: if you want in-game customization, please install the [ResPackOpts](https://modrinth.com/mod/respackopts) mod along side this resource pack. I also highly recommend you do this anyways if you're already using a fabric/neoforge modpack.

**Updating:** After installing a new version of this pack, please make sure *any* old ones are gone, delete them if not. Otherwise RPO functionality will break.

---


<details>
<summary>A word about the history and future of this resource pack</summary>

The main goal of this resource pack initially was to just make rainbow redstone possible in Vanilla minecraft, which at the time I thought was impossible until I discovered and learned how [TCTC Cherry](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/tctc-cherry) does it. After that and making the very first alpha version of RR (Rainbow Redstone), I realized that I wanted this to go so much further than simply rainbow dust. Polishing the versions, I decided to add customization and it kinda went downhill from there. I am now planning on making this *the most* customizeable redstone dust in any pack ever, including color, shape, and so much more. I'm hoping ya'll enjoy it and are as excited as I am to the future this potentially holds! :3

</details>



---

Inspiration and inital code/files for blockstate and models for the dust were taken from [TCTC Cherry](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/tctc-cherry), altho at this point the pack has 0 resemblence to the original idea, as _everything_ has been modified and re-build from ground up.
